metadata.name: Safely Limited Speed (SLS) for Inching Mode
metadata.description: SLS in inching mode: safety PLC, dual-channel mechanically-guided guard switch B1 (two contacts B1.1/B1.2), dual-channel inching pushbutton S1 (I1.0/I1.1), dual encoder feedback, two-channel output (contactor Q1 + inverter T1). Category 3 / PL d per EN ISO 13849-1.

elements.name: B1 Guard switch — contact 1
elements.description: Guard switch B1, first contact (channel A) into the Safety PLC. B1 is a single mechanically-guided limit switch whose guard actuation moves two independent contacts B1.1 and B1.2.

elements.name: B1 Guard switch — contact 2
elements.description: Guard switch B1, second contact (channel B) into the Safety PLC — the redundant channel of the same mechanically-guided switch.

elements.name: S1 Inching pushbutton — contact 1
elements.description: Inching pushbutton S1, contact 1 (channel A) into the Safety PLC (I1.0). Dual-channel enabling button.

elements.name: S1 Inching pushbutton — contact 2
elements.description: Inching pushbutton S1, contact 2 (channel B) into the Safety PLC (I1.1). Dual-channel enabling button.

elements.name: K1 Safety PLC
elements.description: Safety PLC executing SLS logic: compares desired/actual speeds, monitors guard and inching inputs, drives the two output channels.

elements.name: Q1 Contactor
elements.description: Contactor driven by the Safety PLC — output channel 1, electromechanically disconnecting power to the inverter.

elements.name: T1 Frequency inverter
elements.description: Frequency inverter — output channel 2, receiving Start/Stop and Pulse-blocking safety signals from the Safety PLC.

elements.name: M1 3~
elements.description: Three-phase motor driven by the inverter, operating in SLS mode during inching.

elements.name: G1 Encoder channel 1 (n1_actual)
elements.description: First encoder providing actual speed feedback to the Safety PLC.

elements.name: G2 Encoder channel 2 (n2_actual)
elements.description: Second independent encoder for speed comparison and diagnostic coverage.
